Total since last night. 1.5 inches fell in the past hour.

Rainfall from 5:30 to 8 AM Ditches and drainage areas running at capacity. Rainfall continues as of 8 AM.
24 hour total of 1.92 inches with 1.20 inches falling this morning.
Catfish Creek out of its banks and affecting portions of Swiss Valley Park campground. Water currently receding. Campground was evacuated prior to water impacts this morning.
Little Maquoketa River out of its banks and flooding over half of Graf Road.
Overnight total since Friday afternoon_ still raining steadily at time of report.
rain has ended. Storms total through noon.
Rainfall total from 4 AM to 11 AM.
Estimate of 4 inches of rain at Apple River Canyon. Shared via local broadcast media.
Initial report lost due to comms issues. Creek in town out of its banks and still rising.
Water over West River Drive and South Howell Street with vehicles stranded. Delayed report.
County Home Road impassable due to high water.
Pictures of Dry Creek flooding in Palo. Time of flooding estimated from river gage.
Road washed out due to flash flooding.
Two day total. 1.93 inches were just from midnight to 7 AM this morning. Monthly total of 8.88 inches so far.
Precipitation total from all of Saturday and through 7 AM this morning.
Water over the road due to flash flooding. River Road is barricaded.
Water rescue of a family at Eden Valley Campground by fire department.
Lingering flooding of Dry Creek out of its banks in Boyson Park.
Since 5 PM last evening. 36 hour total 4.2 inches.
US Highway 6 closed due to flooding on roadway.
East Wapsinonoc Creek out of its banks. Some water on U.S. Highway 6 but is open.
Slowly receding water on multiple roads near Goose Creek.
